main_text.head: PRO ASTROLOGIA
Discursus.
main_text.p: VENUS τὲ admodum Euripides fingit Silenum atq; Satyrorum chorum Jovem & astra contemplari, hos vero ab hac contemplatione ferocientem Cyclopem dehortari cum increpatione, sic enim fingit Cyclopem eos affari:
Τί φαλῖς[?], τὶ λέγεις, τύχαλις[?] ὑμῶν τῷ ξύλῳ[?]
Δάκρυα μεξήσει[?], βλέπεις ἄνω ἢ μὴ κάτω[?].

Quid loquimini, quid dicitis? celeriter quispiam vobis fuste lacrymas movebit; sursum videtis & non deorsum. At Silenum Cyclopi respondentem introducit, ut citra metum fateatur suam in contemplandis sideribus diligentiam, sic enim Cyclopem alloquitur:
Ἰδὼ[?] ὡς ἐς αὐτὸν τὸν Δί[?] ἀνάκεκυφαμεν[?],
Καὶ τ᾽ ἄστρα[?], τὴν ἀεὶ[?] ὠρίωνα[?] δέχομαι[?].

Ecce ad ipsum Jovem oculos direximus, astraq; & Orionem aspicio. Quo quidem de duabus ingeniorum humanorum differentiis Poëta nos admonet, quarum alteram in Sileno, alteram proponit in Cyclope, fingit tamen neutram earum legibus, disciplinis aut assuefactione, seu humana societate institutam, sed sequi eas tantum motus à natura implantatos. Fingit Silenum in servitute degentem, quotidianis curis & voluptatibus deditum, nihilominus tamen quandoq; de divinis & rebus in natura bonis cogitare. page.notes: The Greek verse lines are uncertain at several points, marked [?]; the Euripides quotation (Cyclops) should be checked against the source. Underlined words (Euripides, Sileno, Cyclope, implantatos) are probably italic in the original; I have not marked them as italic because they are not clearly distinguishable. Handwritten annotations in the right margin ("Imago mentis ... Silenus") are not printed text and are excluded. The line "cèt" at the lower right is the catchword for "licet".
